card.title: Professional Assessment Required — bleach spill on wool
card.stainChemistry: This stain and material combination requires careful professional evaluation.
card.whyThisWorks: Some stain/material combinations carry risk of permanent damage if the wrong agent is used. A professional assessment ensures the right treatment.

spottingProtocol.instruction: Do not attempt to treat this stain yourself.
Take the item to a professional cleaner as soon as possible.
Describe the stain type and how long ago it occurred.
Do not apply any household products — they may set the stain permanently.

materialWarnings: Wool — no chlorine bleach, no hot water, no aggressive scrubbing. Blot with cold water.
Professional assessment required for this combination.
card.escalation: Take to a professional cleaner immediately. Do not attempt home treatment.
